conclusion: Both halves landed with zero sorrys and standard axioms only: O9Seam.r_comp_mem and Retention.rIv_mem are retired at no reproof cost after re-running the use-site survey, and the two-mode arithmetic is proved (dam_le_of_box) and instantiated at a real recorded box from the kernel's own chunk verdict (dam_le_box0). Landing it required closing a prerequisite nobody had named: nothing in the package related BandDual.Phi2 to the retention integrals Qre and Qim, so O9Bridge.lean proves that identity first.
confidence: Lean-kernel confidence on everything stated: four targeted lake builds exit 0, every new declaration prints [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], and the headline result is instantiated at a point of a table box rather than left conditional, so the vacuity failure mode that killed r_comp_mem is checked and not merely avoided. Lean less on the framing: this closes the step O9Assemble named and does NOT close O9 soundness. Two things stand between it and the retention obligation, both stated in RESULTS.md section 5, and the first (no Lean-side covering of the window by the recorded boxes) is a real piece of work, not a rewrite.
